readings.title: The Quiet Room
readings.text: The room was quiet enough for careful thought. She struggled to maintain her composure as the meeting continued.

transfer_tasks.prompt: Do you enjoy spending time alone?
transfer_tasks.response_structure: 观点 → 原因 → 具体例子
hints: Give one reason and one concrete example.
transfer_tasks.model_answer: I tend to enjoy some time alone because it helps me recover; for example, I read quietly after work.

transfer_tasks.prompt: After a stressful day, what would you do to clear your mind? Use take time to reflect.
hints: Answer in a new situation without copying the lesson sentence.
transfer_tasks.model_answer: I would take time to reflect before deciding what to do next.
